setupSteps.title: Install Git
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Git responds with a version number

setupSteps.title: Install Node LTS
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Node responds with a version number

steps.title: Download Ollama
steps.body: PlantGPT's engine. Chat runs inside Ollama on your own Mac — free, no account.

steps.title: Put Ollama in Applications
steps.body: Unzip the download, drag Ollama in, open it once. A llama icon joins the menu bar.
steps.verifierLabel: The llama icon is in the menu bar

steps.title: Get a chat model
steps.body: About 2 GB. On a 16 GB+ Mac, pull qwen2.5:7b instead for better answers.

steps.title: Install Rust
steps.body: Tauri's core is Rust. Run the single command the page shows, then reopen Terminal.
steps.verifierLabel: cargo responds with a version number

expect.prompt: In the terminal, has the rustup installer finished — a line such as "Rust is installed now. Great!", with the prompt back and no error? Answer not done while it is still downloading or still asking which installation option to use.

hints: Paste the command rustup.rs shows into Terminal and take the default install.
Already finished? Open a new Terminal window — cargo only joins the PATH of new shells.

steps.title: Get PlantGPT
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d plantgpt/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/plantgpt.git
fi
cd plantgpt
git checkout 0e2cf7ae118beee65d9a07c1659de2b2ab4b85cd
steps.verifierLabel: You are inside the plantgpt folder

steps.title: Build PlantGPT
steps.body: First build compiles Rust — 10 to 20 minutes. The app lands in the bundle folder.
steps.command:
npm install
npm run tauri build --bundles app
steps.verifierLabel: The build finishes with a PlantGPT.app

expect.prompt: In the terminal, has `npm run tauri build` finished with a Finished/bundled line naming PlantGPT.app, with no error after it?

hints: "xcrun: error" usually means Xcode's command line tools aren't installed — run xcode-select --install.
First build compiles every Rust dependency from scratch — it can look stuck; give it time.

steps.title: Put PlantGPT in Applications
steps.body: Copy the freshly built app into Applications so it's a real, launchable Mac app.
steps.verifierLabel: PlantGPT.app is in your Applications folder

steps.title: Open PlantGPT
steps.body: Built on your own machine, so macOS opens it without any warning.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.body: PlantGPT finds Ollama at localhost:11434 by itself. Ask anything — it streams locally.

expect.prompt: In the PlantGPT window, has an assistant reply finished streaming below the user's message, rather than an empty thread or an error banner?

hints: If PlantGPT says Ollama is offline, open the Ollama app once and try again.
A first reply can take a minute — the model loads into memory on the first message.
